# Lennar

> > America's leading homebuilder offering new single-family homes, townhomes, and master-planned communities with smart home technology and energy-efficient features.

Lennar builds and sells new homes across the United States, with significant presence in Florida (Palm Beach County, Tampa-Manatee, Land O' Lakes), Texas (Dallas-Ft Worth), Indiana, and other growing markets. The company specializes in move-in-ready homes with Everything's Included® features, serving first-time buyers, families, and active adults through master-planned communities.

## Home Search & Buying Tools

- [Lennar Homepage - New Homes For Sale](https://stage.lennar.com/): Main homepage for exploring new homes in Florida, Palm Beach County, and nationwide with community search and homebuyer resources
- [Homebuyer Quiz](https://buy.lennar.com/): Interactive quiz to help find the perfect new home in Chula Vista, Las Vegas, and other markets based on buyer preferences
